rows.grounds: compound: tvat (your) + vaktra (face) + ambuja (lotus) + pīyūṣa (nectar) + pāna (drinking); instrumental expresses means
vocative address to the goddess; compound kamala (lotus) + ānana (face)

items.question: What sustaining nectar does the devotee drink from the lotus-faced goddess?
premises: The speaker addresses a lotus-faced goddess.
The speaker drinks nectar from her lotus-face.
This drinking signifies intimate devotional experience.
items.inference: Devotional fulfillment arises through tasting the goddess's nectar.
uncertainties: vaktra may be read as face or mouth, affecting the image's nuance.
items.plain_english: By drinking the nectar of your lotus-face, O lotus-faced one.
